data.title: 100 Thieves Win Probability Drops in Polymarket Valorant Match
data.description: The win probability for 100 Thieves in Polymarket’s submarket for the Valorant match between 100 Thieves and LOUD in the VCT Americas Stage 2 playoffs fell sharply from 81.5% one hour earlier to 58.5%, a 23-point swing. According to ChainCatcher, the move was tracked by Catcher Predict monitoring and may reflect the impact of breaking news.

data.title: Amazon Cargo Jet Overruns Runway, Shuts Miami Airport
data.description:
An Amazon.com Inc. cargo plane overran a runway at Miami International Airport on Sunday and burst into flames, according to Bloomberg.

The incident shut down the airport’s runways and taxiways and prompted an emergency response.

data.title: Peter Schiff Rejects Bitcoin Backing Argument As BTC Trades Near $79,600
data.description:
Peter Schiff reopened the Bitcoin-backing debate, arguing that miners’ energy use leaves nothing behind to support Bitcoin, while Bitcoin maximalist Jeff Swanson had called the asset the future of money. According to BeInCrypto, Schiff said energy is gone once spent, so it cannot back Bitcoin, and he contrasted that with gold, which remains after mining.

Swanson also cited $39 trillion in U.S. debt, but Treasury data put total public debt above $40 trillion on Aug. 18 and at $40.10 trillion on Sept. 3. Bitcoin (BTC) traded near $79,600 on Sunday, down about 1.5% over 24 hours.

data.title: Iran to Raise Gasoline Prices for High-Usage Consumers
data.description: According to Jin10, Iranian government spokesperson Fatemeh Mohajerani said on Sunday that Iran will raise gasoline prices for users who consume more than 110 liters per month starting Tuesday. She said the first and second quota tiers, including 110 liters, will remain unchanged, while the third-tier quota price will rise to 100,000 Iranian rials per liter, or about 4 cents at the free-market exchange rate. Mohajerani said the increase will affect only consumers who need more than 110 liters of gasoline per month, and that the adjustment is due to the current situation. She added that other drivers can still buy up to 60 liters at 15,000 rials per liter and another 50 liters at 30,000 rials per liter.

data.title: Kalshi Settles Michigan Market Early, Then Reverses Payouts
data.description:
Kalshi prematurely settled its Western Michigan vs. Michigan market before the game ended, paying traders on the losing side and then clawing back those payouts after the result changed. The market drew $18.6 million in volume, according to BeInCrypto, and Kalshi later reimbursed the wrongly marked losers and paid Michigan holders last.

The exchange’s own sports account highlighted a $2,265 Western Michigan position that would have paid $93,201. The error came after a Michigan judge barred Kalshi from offering sports contracts in the state on September 1, with a $500,000 daily penalty.

data.title: White Hat Message Follows Transfer of About 4,000 BTC Linked to Liquid Network Peg-Out
data.description: About 4,000 BTC out of 4,200 BTC linked to a Liquid Network peg-out transaction appear to have been transferred at the same time. According to Odaily, a subsequent transaction included an OP_RETURN message saying, "We are white hats, please contact us on-chain." It is not yet clear what the transaction was or whether the funds were moved through an exploit.
